S.FORM: == bihkac == u sulit nu zuma a kamu u sulit nu Hulam 捕獸器 u sulit nu Lipun 罠 またはトラップ u sulit nu Amilka Animal trapping, or simply trapping u siwkay nu bihkac- sakapaluwaluway u bihkac sa ,u sapiadup tu aadupen nu miadupay. sangaen nu muking, tusa ku sicekaay, buhatay ku sicekay patizeng i zazan nu aadupen. anu mazipa ku aadupen sa, amatahap ku sicekaay, mahiza ku ngipen, makalad, makelem nu bihkac. mazikeptu ku aadupan a kuku'. saicelang ku bihekac. pacekan i lala sanay, caykalimad. u canan a aadupen ku mazikep uyniay a bihkac, maala ku caket, sizi,kiyuma,ngabul, caykaala ku tumay, tatabaki ku tumay. u canan a cidekay matineng misanga atu miadup u miadupay a ingcumin, matinengtu sapibihekac, matinengtu misanga. ayzasa caytu misanga ku miadupay, cakayhan i tishiba, izawtu ku pacakayay. u zuma a bihkac nu Sakizaya izawtu ku sapitekelay a bihekac, caykaw nu mukingay a bihkac, u auk atu kilang. caykaw icelang ku ayam atu tulakuk, u auk atu kilangay a bihkac, tanengtu mazikep tu ayam atu tulakuk.
S.PHON: biħkaʦ u su[r|ɾ]it nu zuma a kamu u su[r|ɾ]it nu ħu[r|ɾ]am *** u su[r|ɾ]it nu [r|ɾ]ipun * ******* u su[r|ɾ]it nu ami[r|ɾ]ka anima[r|ɾ] trappiŋ or simp[r|ɾ]j trappiŋ u siwkaj nu biħkaʦ sakapa[r|ɾ]uwa[r|ɾ]uwaj u biħkaʦ sa u sapiadup tu aadupən nu miadupaj saŋaən nu mukiŋ tusa ku siʦəkaaj buħataj ku siʦəkaj patizəŋ i zazan nu aadupən anu mazipa ku aadupən sa amataħap ku siʦəkaaj maħiza ku ŋipən maka[r|ɾ]ad makə[r|ɾ]əm nu biħkaʦ mazikəptu ku aadupan a kuku[ʔ|ʡ] saiʦə[r|ɾ]aŋ ku biħəkaʦ paʦəkan i [r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]a sanaj ʦajka[r|ɾ]imad u ʦanan a aadupən ku mazikəp ujniaj a biħkaʦ maa[r|ɾ]a ku ʦakət sizikijumaŋabu[r|ɾ] ʦajkaa[r|ɾ]a ku tumaj tatabaki ku tumaj u ʦanan a ʦidəkaj matinəŋ misaŋa atu miadup u miadupaj a iŋʦumin matinəŋtu sapibiħəkaʦ matinəŋtu misaŋa ajzasa ʦajtu misaŋa ku miadupaj ʦakajħan i tisħiba izawtu ku paʦakajaj u zuma a biħkaʦ nu sakizaja izawtu ku sapitəkə[r|ɾ]aj a biħəkaʦ ʦajkaw nu mukiŋaj a biħkaʦ u auk atu ki[r|ɾ]aŋ ʦajkaw iʦə[r|ɾ]aŋ ku ajam atu tu[r|ɾ]akuk u auk atu ki[r|ɾ]aŋaj a biħkaʦ tanəŋtu mazikəp tu ajam atu tu[r|ɾ]akuk
